description: Use this tool whenever a user asks about state income tax deductions or credits for 529 college savings contributions across any U.S. state or DC, Tax-Parity states (AZ, AR, KS, ME, MN, MO, MT, OH, PA), K-12 $20,000/yr state conformity traps (CA, NY, etc.), 5-year gift-tax superfunding ($95,000 Single / $190,000 Married on Form 709), or rolling up to $35,000 of unused 529 funds into a beneficiary Roth IRA under SECURE 2.0 Sec. 126.

agi.description: Household Adjusted Gross Income in USD (screens state income caps in NJ, ME, MN, OR).

numBeneficiaries.description: Number of beneficiaries (multiplies per-beneficiary state caps).

state.description: Full U.S. state name or "District of Columbia" (e.g. "California", "New York", "Illinois", "Pennsylvania", "Indiana").
